Stephen T. Hamilton

American Constitution candidate for Governor and Lieutenant Governor, Colorado · Open seat

Truck driver

Stephen T. Hamilton is the American Constitution Party nominee for Governor of Colorado in the November 3, 2026 general election. He lives in Cañon City and filed his candidate affidavit with the Colorado Secretary of State on October 29, 2024. He says he is not a career politician.

Where Hamilton stands

Housing and cost of living
Says housing fixes in the High Country differ from the Front Range. Proposes more state incentives for deed-restricted workforce housing, faster approval of modular and manufactured housing, and opening up underused state and federal land.
Housing
Proposes changing construction-defect and insurance rules that he says block condo projects. Also proposes faster state permits for small infill projects and keeping local housing dollars from being moved into Front Range funding formulas.
Water
In an op-ed for his campaign, says he will work to defend Colorado's water if elected.
Public safety
In Ballotpedia's candidate survey, says people who caused harm to anyone in Colorado will face full justice. Says the founding documents and the original intentions of George Washington will be imposed.
Emergency powers
Asked when a governor should use emergency powers, says government-sponsored riots inside Colorado would be treated as treason under the constitution.
